Kim — short note from infra ops POV: if Bellwether will be forwarding invites into the EU and APAC calendars, anchor to UTC in the iCalendar (TZID=UTC) or explicitly set DTSTART/DTEND with TZID in the .ics. Some corporate calendar stacks (older Exchange / Outlook clients) drop the TZID and treat it as floating which causes the 1-hour shift when DST rules are different.

If we want to avoid admin back-and-forth, easiest is: we send one invite anchored to UTC and add the local equivalent in the event description for clarity. I can generate an "UTC-anchored" .ics and send it once you confirm the slot.

— Marcus
